segments.vv2:1.1: “Pīṭhaṃ te veḷuriyamayaṃ uḷāraṃ, manojavaṃ gacchati yenakāmaṃ;
segments.vv2:2.1: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo, kena te idha mijjhati;
segments.vv2:2.3: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.
segments.vv2:3.1: “Pucchāmi taṃ devi mahānubhāve, manussabhūtā kimakāsi puññaṃ;
segments.vv2:3.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv2:4.3: Pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv2:5.3: Abhivādayiṃ añjalikaṃ akāsiṃ, yathānubhāvañca adāsi dānaṃ.
segments.vv2:6.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo, tena me idha mijjhati;
segments.vv2:6.3: Uppajjanti ca me bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.
segments.vv2:7.1: “Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva, manussabhūtā yamakāsi puññaṃ;
segments.vv2:7.3: Tenamhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
